text.tspan: 2 locks in tail; 1 remains at A[0]. Array is FULLY SORTED!

text.font-family: "Segoe Print", "Bradley Hand", Chilanka, "Comic Sans MS", "Comic Neue", cursive
text.tspan: Each extraction locks the maximum of the active heap at the end, then restores the heap in O(log n) time.
Total sorting phase time: (n - 1) * O(log n) = O(n log n). In-place and non-stable.

text.font-family: "Segoe Print", "Bradley Hand", Chilanka, "Comic Sans MS", "Comic Neue", cursive
text.tspan: Each extraction swaps the root maximum to the end and sifts down the new root in O(log n) time.
